source.title: Existence Results and Open Problems in the Kinetic Theory of Dense Gases

trace.notes: Normalized URL https://zbmath.org/5309939 as zbMATH record 5309939. Direct zbMATH page access returned a Cloudflare challenge, so the zbMATH API was used only as resolver metadata and identified title, author W. Greenberg, year 2008, pages 17-32, identifier 1151.82389, and DOI candidate 10.1007/978-3-540-74339-2_2 through linked resolver metadata.

Crossref confirmed the exact DOI 10.1007/978-3-540-74339-2_2 and title, and exposed Springer landing and PDF URLs. The Springer landing page was metadata/abstract access only, with meta access="No"; the direct PDF request returned HTML rather than a readable PDF. A Springer page-one preview was available but contained only the first two pages, not the full chapter body needed for extraction.

OpenAlex confirmed the same DOI and title but reported open_access.is_oa=false, oa_status=closed, best_oa_location=null, and any_repository_has_fulltext=false. Exact-work searches for the title plus PDF and title plus author did not recover a confirmed readable full-text PDF or HTML copy for the same work; candidates were metadata pages, abstracts, snippets, or the same Springer landing page.

Input could not be normalized to a readable PDF or HTML full-text source. Failure mode: paywalled_or_restricted, with a blocked_or_challenged bibliographic resolver. No open questions were extracted because the available artifacts were metadata, abstract text, or an incomplete preview rather than the technical problem statements.
Saved exact JSON to outputs/parse-paper/5309939.json and outputs/latest.json.
